summary: Ty::from_str panics on invalid non-ASCII input such as "éééééé" because its enumeration-prefix check slices at byte 11, inside a UTF-8 character. The fix uses starts_with and strip_prefix so this input returns an invalid-type error. The fix adds the selected regression test. This plan reverses only the implementation changes; no tests were run.
expected_failure: byte index 11 is not a char boundary
